craft_notes: Sthāyin: alphabet-wonder. Rows: row 8 (high vowels lift). Rupture: semicolon after dot. Close: naming. Rejected: 'lunar mansions' — killed: moon-days plain; 'copulation' for yoga — killed: yoking kept.

lines: First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the bindu-dot;
within them, time-yoked, moon and sun are named.
l4.sanskrit_cite: athādyās tithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānakāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau
